warmup_screening_note: Last-five CV or absolute fitted drift above 5% prompts inspection; it is not a significance test.

manual_warmup_review.decision: Retain all original samples. Last two warmups dipped; timed values rebound rather than continuing a downward trend. This is a screening flag, not proof of inadequate warmup. All three optimized fork means are below all three baseline means, with no allocation stalls. Disclose flag and inspection in final report; do not remove individual iterations or rerun just the favorable variant.

environment_review.limitation: Environment snapshots are taken between cases; they do not provide continuous host activity tracing.
